__comment: Pig Tail — a fibrous annual surface crop, the colony's primary source of raw cloth fiber.
Grown on surface dirt farm plots with open sky. Cannot grow underground.
Annual: after harvest the farm plot returns to FALLOW. Dwarves must re-seed from
pig_tail_seed items each spring. Seeds have a 40% chance to drop on harvest,
so a well-managed field is self-sustaining — but only just.
PLACEMENT: Surface dirt farm plots only (base:terrain:surface:dirt_NN).
Requires open sky — no solid block within 10 blocks above.
3 clear air blocks above required for dwarf access.
SEASONS: Annual crop — does not survive winter.
If a plant is in the 'seedling' stage when winter arrives, the plot
returns to FALLOW at the season change and the seedling is lost.
Dwarves should sow in early spring to guarantee a full harvest before autumn.
Only 'summer' and 'autumn' model keys are needed; seedling uses summer only.
GROWTH: Two stages — seedling → mature.
seedling: 8 in-game days → advances to mature.
mature: final stage; stays until harvested.
After harvest the plot returns to FALLOW. Re-seed manually.
YIELD: 4× pig_tail fiber + 1× pig_tail_seed (40% chance).
Fiber is processed at the brewery (2× pig_tail → 1× cloth).
See the planned brewing recipes in docs/40_economy_colony/42_farming_brewing.md.
